defect: The navigation tab strip and the two tool buttons rendered as raw browser-default controls. index.html used .tab-strip and bare <button> elements, while navigation.css only defines .navigation-tabs, .navigation-tab and the button classes. No rule matched, so those controls fell back to unstyled browser defaults.
fix: Renamed the markup classes to the ones the stylesheet actually defines, and set align-items to center on .navigation-shell so its children stop inflating to the grid row height.
servedFrom: site/dist (the built artifact, not the source tree)
method: hidden Windows desktop, isolated guest Edge profile with sync and extensions disabled, exactly one CDP page target verified before capture, background window capture by handle

captures.shows: Tab strip and tool buttons rendered as raw browser-default grey controls above the styled header.
The same controls rendered as Material pills and tonal buttons, with the selected tab carrying its tonal background.

knownRemaining: The two tool buttons still stack full width rather than sitting inline beside the search field, and a gap remains between the navigation shell and the hero. Both predate this repair and are not caused by it.
